crime: Every evening, once the others had gone downstairs, one girl called {WITCH_NAME}'s name at the upper railing, and {WITCH_NAME}'s Magic set her at the girl's side at once. The girl would hang on to her wrist and lean far out over the courtyard to feed a nest in the tree.
Every night at nine, the prisoners called her name in the lounge as well. She never came unless she was called.
One evening at the railing, the girl told her the fledglings had flown. Tonight she only wanted the empty nest, to keep. After that, she wouldn't call her again.
{WITCH_NAME}'s mother used to ring the supper bell and call her brothers in by name. The door would shut while she still waited on the step to hear her own.
Just before nine, at the railing, {WITCH_NAME} pressed her wrist into the girl's hand. "I have you," she said. "Reach all the way out."

At nine, the prisoners called her name in the lounge and turned to find her already beside them. Moments later, a scream and a crash came from the courtyard. They found the railing empty and the girl dead on the path below, the empty nest beside her.
In the trial court, they ruled that she had fallen alone, reaching for the nest. {WITCH_NAME} had been standing among them when it happened.

Then {WITCH_NAME}'s sleeve slid back, and one prisoner saw four small fingertip bruises ringing her wrist. They understood at last: the girl had been hanging from that wrist, and their nine o'clock call had taken it out of her grip.
fields.epitaph: She waited her whole life to be called, and in the end let a call do her letting go.
fields.epithet: The girl no one called in to supper
execution: A giant supper bell rises above her, then sinks over her head until its rim rests on her shoulders. Her ankles are fixed to the floor beneath it.
The bell begins to peal for supper. Inside, the clapper swings around her head and strikes it on every swing, so each peal comes out as a dull thud.
At last she sags to her knees and slips out from under the lip. Above her still head, the bell rings clear.

magic.name: Come When Called
magic.text: She teleports to the side of anyone who calls her name.
